author: Vikas Yarlagadda
message:
Fix methodology discrepancies to match paper (arXiv 2505.13933)

- AR(1), AR(3), ARMAX: fix expanding window → fixed-size rolling window
- ARMAX: fix AR order from (1,0,0) to (3,0,0) per paper spec
- HAR, HARX: fix rolling_window_end off-by-one (len(train)-1 → len(train))
- HARX: fix subsample start (277 → 0) to use full training window
- HARX: expand exogenous vars from 4 to all available macro predictors
- DM test: replace simple variance with Newey-West HAC estimator (Bartlett kernel)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: Vikas Yarlagadda
message:
Align hyperparameters with paper specifications

LSTM.ipynb:
- batch_size: 256 → 64 (paper Section IV)

classical_reservoir.ipynb:
- input_scaling: 1.0 → 0.1 (paper Section IV)
- Use paper's fixed reservoir sizes: CRL N=50, CRLX N=20
  instead of searching N=20-100

These were the two significant parameter discrepancies between
the code and arXiv:2505.13933.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: Vikas Yarlagadda
message:
Fix QR prediction scale mismatch — root cause of wrong results

The shipped predict_result.csv contains QR predictions in the original
denormalized log-RV scale (range [-3.9, -1.7]) because the Julia code
applied denormalization(Max_RV, Min_RV, Pre, -1, 0) before saving.

However, all Python-side models and the actual RV target operate in the
Data.CSV normalized scale (range [-1, 0]).

Fix: renormalize QR predictions back to [-1, 0] when loading:
  qr_norm = (qr_raw - Min_RV) / dif - 1

After this fix, QR1 MSE=0.0085 and QR2 MSE=0.0084, which are competitive
with ARMAX (0.0084) and better than AR3/LSTM/CRL — consistent with the
paper's reported results.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: Vikas Yarlagadda
message:
Add preprocessing script and generated artifacts

preprocess.py reads Data.CSV, runs ADF stationarity tests on each column,
differences non-stationary columns (DP→diff_DP, TB→diff_TB), fills NaN
with 0, and writes Data_raw.csv and dff.csv to the repo root.

This unblocks LSTM.ipynb and classical_reservoir.ipynb, both of which
fail at their first cell without these files.
